hypothesis.frozen_statement: Current sources can be compiled from explicit pointers while excluding superseded evidence.
falsification_conditions: a declared-superseded object appears in the compiled current source set
a live pointer chain cannot be compiled from the entrypoint without manual narrative
the compiled result depends on the working tree instead of the pinned commit
hypothesis.qualification: Compilation from explicit pointers works and excludes superseded evidence, but only because four anchored classification rules replace the naive rules a first implementation would use. Each naive rule was measured to give a different and wrong answer on the live estate.

mechanism.summary: A pointer-driven compiler that reads a declarative spec and every referenced object through git cat-file at one pinned commit, walks the pointer graph from the repository entrypoint's reading order, classifies each reachable object as a current launch surface, immutable evidence or retained superseded evidence, and fails closed on broken active references, routing cycles and ambiguous single-valued pointer roles.
gate_rules: MISSING_REFERENCED_OBJECT when an active role names a path absent at the commit
SUPERSEDED_OBJECT_REACHED_BY_ACTIVE_ROLE when a superseded object is also named by a live launch role
ROUTING_POINTER_CYCLE when routing roles form a cycle
AMBIGUOUS_SINGLE_VALUED_ROLE when one single-valued role resolves to more than one live target
anchored_classification_rules: supersession is declared by a superseded* pointer key, by a standing value that starts with the superseded prefix, by an explicit spec entry, or by a disposition row; a standing that merely mentions supersession is not a declaration
pointer roles skip generic locator keys such as path and uri, so the enclosing pointer key carries the routing meaning
backward lineage roles may name superseded objects without promoting them or failing the gate
roles that declare an absence preserve an evidential defect instead of reporting a broken reference
supporting_tools: tools/run_cases.py materialises each synthetic estate as a real repository and checks frozen expectations
tools/counterfactual.py replays naive rule variants over one compiled report
tools/run_clean_clone.sh reproduces the unit from a fresh clone with an emptied environment
hermetic_properties: all bytes read through git cat-file at an explicit commit
standard library only, runs under python3 -I
deterministic output digest with no timestamps in the compiled report
no network, no /tmp state reuse, no provider memory

experiments.question: Does the live instruction estate compile to a current source set that excludes superseded evidence?
Do the gate rules hold on eleven frozen synthetic estates, including the required superseded-pointer exclusion case?
Would a simpler classifier have produced the same verdict on the live estate?
Is every rule covered by a dependency-free test, including hermeticity and CLI exit separation?
Does the seeded PO-03 custody suite still pass in this clone alongside the new unit?

discoveries.statement: A substring test for supersession misclassifies the live v010 payload, whose own current standing names the superseded v009 predecessor. Supersession must be read from an anchored declaration.

The live estate distinguishes supersedes_pointer from superseded_pointer by one character. A prefix rule that ignores the difference either promotes retired evidence or fails a valid lineage edge, so lineage roles need their own class.

The estate deliberately preserves the absent v008 object as an evidential defect. A blanket broken-reference gate fails the healthy repository, so declared absence and broken reference are separate states.

Obzio pointers wrap targets in locator objects, so a leaf-key role reading resolves every pointer to the role name 'path' and silently disables single-valued ambiguity detection on all four control roles.

Three superseded rows in the current disposition table name object families in prose rather than repository paths, so a path-level compiler cannot enforce them. The rows are reported as unresolved rather than silently dropped.
unresolved_rows: Operator D directive, reference, recovery state and preflight

mechanism_change_proposals.proposal: Adopt anchored supersession declarations, lineage roles, declared-absence roles and enclosing-key role naming as the shared currentness contract, and run the compiler in CI as a fail-closed currentness gate over the entrypoint chain.
mechanism_change_proposals.reason: Shared PO-03 control and workflow paths belong to the integration controller. This unit ships the executable mechanism and evidence inside its owned slot only.

mechanism_change_proposals.proposal: Add backticked repository paths to the three prose-only superseded rows so a compiler can enforce their disposition.
mechanism_change_proposals.reason: The disposition document is outside this unit's owned paths and is founder-facing routing evidence.

atomic_lease_claim.mechanism: git push --force-with-lease with an empty expected value, which only succeeds when the remote ref does not exist

obzio_state_note: This producer does not set RESULT_STAGING or later custody states. The controller ingests the immutable result commit through transactional_factory.ingest_committed_result, and a different producer performs independent acceptance.
